# SwapPulse v0.8.0 — PokemonPriceTracker graded and recent-market enrichment

This release adds a fourth specialised Pokémon data layer for RAW prices, graded sold-price information and recent history while preserving TCGDex as the canonical catalogue.

## Added
- Server-only PokemonPriceTracker API client.
- `pokemon-price-tracker-market` Base44 backend function.
- Private `PokemonPriceTrackerCache` and `PokemonPriceTrackerUsage` entities.
- Card Detail graded/recent-market panel translated across SwapPulse's supported interface languages.
- Admin external-API budget card showing PokemonPriceTracker credit/rate headroom alongside PokéWallet usage.
- Privacy, architecture, API and third-party documentation for the new provider.

## Data model and provider role
- TCGDex remains canonical for card identity, set identity and catalogue data.
- PokéAPI remains species/game enrichment.
- PokéWallet remains a TCGPlayer/CardMarket cross-check.
- PokemonPriceTracker adds RAW/condition, graded sold-price and recent-history data only.

## Free-tier controls
The Free plan is treated as:
- 100 credits/day;
- 60 requests/minute;
- 3 days of recent history;
- RAW and graded card-price access.

SwapPulse reserves operational headroom by using an 80-credit/day soft budget and 75% of the configured per-minute request ceiling.

A fully enriched card is budgeted as 3 credits: basic card data plus recent history plus graded/eBay data. Responses are cached for 24 hours and can use a short stale fallback during temporary provider failures. There is no background collection-wide refresh on the Free plan.

## Matching safety
- The browser supplies only a canonical TCGDex card ID.
- The backend builds a strict provider search from card name, set and collector number.
- Automatic mapping requires matching collector number and a sufficiently strong combined score.
- Low-confidence candidates are rejected instead of guessed.

## Licensing/commercial-use safety
PokemonPriceTracker's dedicated licensing page currently says revenue-bearing sites require Business, including product-linked donations. Some provider pricing pages contain conflicting commercial-use wording. SwapPulse follows the stricter dedicated licensing guidance and therefore fails closed for ordinary public production traffic on Free/API plans.

Admins may exercise the integration for development/evaluation. Public use becomes eligible only when Business/Enterprise is configured or the maintainer has explicit written permission and deliberately enables the documented override.

SwapPulse does not expose PokemonPriceTracker data as a public proxy API, bulk feed or substitute data product.

## Security/privacy
- `POKEMON_PRICE_TRACKER_API_KEY` is read only by backend code.
- Provider credentials are never returned to browser clients or stored in source control.
- Requests use catalogue metadata only and do not require names, emails, account IDs, private notes or Web3 identity evidence.

## Rationale
PokemonPriceTracker provides useful graded and short-history data that complements, rather than replaces, the existing TCGDex/PokéWallet/PokéAPI stack. Strict caching, credit accounting, conservative matching and licence gating keep the integration useful without making the site dependent on a scarce or legally unsuitable Free-tier feed.
